description: Golden vectors for the shared realistic-perception decision read(observer, subject) -> a SENSE (SIGHT | HEARING | NONE) and, for SIGHT and HEARING, the continuous exposure in SECONDS after which the subject is NOTICED (the reaction time), plus the first tick of an unbroken run that reaches it. Both mods (Minecraft-AI CreaturePerception, wrapper combat/Perception) run every case and must agree. See docs/PERCEPTION.md.
caseFields: angleDeg = 3D angle between the observer's look vector and the direction to the subject (0 = straight ahead, 180 = directly behind); distance in blocks (eye to eye; the formula is linear and has no limit, the ENGAGE limit of 64 blocks is the wrapper's engagement rule, not part of the reaction time); subject = {sneaking, visibility (default 1; vanilla invisibility/disguise factor with its own sneak factor divided out)}; heardNear (default false) = a vanilla vibration was heard at the subject's position (hearing is an INPUT: vanilla decides radius, sneaking, wool); occlusionClear (default true) = both the eye ray and the body-centre ray are blocked when false; paramsOverride replaces single params; expectSense = SIGHT | HEARING | NONE; expectSeconds = requiredSeconds = (base + (at64 - base) * distance / 64) * angleFactor * sneakFactor / visibility (angleFactor 1 up to fullAttentionHalfAngleDeg, rising linearly to peripheralMultiplier at peripheralHalfAngleDeg, beyond it not seen; a heard subject with a clear line uses angleFactor 1), or "never"; expectNoticeTick = the first tick of an unbroken run (0 = the tick it starts on) whose exposure (tick * 0.05 s) reaches expectSeconds, -1 for never. runs = exposure sequences: 'sighted' is one char per tick (1 sighted, 0 not); a run tolerates ONE missed tick and starts again from zero after two in a row; expectNoticeIndex is the index of the first tick that reaches 'requiredSeconds' (-1 for never).

peripheral edge 100 deg: factor 2
just behind the field 100.5 deg: never

sneaking at 20 blocks in front

a flat reaction time when base equals the 64 block value

runs.name: an unbroken run of 12 ticks reaches 0.5 s on tick 10
several single misses do not break it either
two missed ticks in a row start the exposure again from zero
broken by two misses every time: never
0 seconds (perception off) is noticed on the first tick
